description.value: More Bikes is a full-service independent bike shop with multiple Vancouver locations — Kitsilano (recently relocated to 1828 W. 4th Ave.), UBC, and West Vancouver. The shop carries a broad range of bikes from Giant, Liv, Kona, Rocky Mountain, Brodie, and Cannondale, including e-bikes across several brands, plus a comprehensive parts and accessories floor. A dedicated repair and maintenance department makes it a practical stop for touring cyclists needing mechanical help on the road.
